profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary: Full-stack software developer, with experience building front-end UIs and coding core operating systems, collaborating with colleagues and clients to launch progressive programs with expanded functionality that elevate the user experience. Design user interfaces (UIs), execute testing protocols, and troubleshoot issues, managing release schedules for on-time hand-off to production.

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack software for medical researchers and physicians to interact with AI-powered tumor identification models

• Built Django backend cloud-based image tiling system to deliver portions of high-resolution medical imagery on demand, reducing rendering time and increasing diagnostic speed for medical practitioners and researchers.
• Implemented React and Next frontends for stable state management, ensuring persistent UI experience during dynamic AI-powered image updates, and secure authentication for API-based image tile access.
• Resolved React external library dependency errors by migrating frontend to Vue, enabling delivery of key menu feature.
• Developed React app to calculate individual heat risks based on demographic data

Developed full-stack software for agricultural professionals to chat with industry-specific, research-based LLM chatbot (CropWizard) and evaluate the quality of multiple LLM models for agricultural AI tools (AI AgriBench)

• Deployed Python script to compare question-answer pairs from ground truth to LLM outputs, leveraging a separate LLM to generate diagnostic metrics, and store results and model specifications in a Supabase database.
• Created and deployed Next web app to display customizable comparison view of LLMs based on accuracy, completeness, conciseness, and relevance across nine topic areas.
• Built backend evaluation engine for “virtual agronomist” offering tailored farming advice, research insights, and data analysis trained on >200K agricultural publications to compare outputs to foundational models and prioritize optimal outputs.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Collaborated to launch new business and user experience for Xbox gaming on mobile devices using existing hardware/software to build and manage net-new functionality, driving 0-1 product from idea to reality:

• Wrote C++ functions on Xbox hardware to enable API-based services to perform original local controller functions via current/future API calls.
• Diagnosed and resolved credentials reset issue causing restart connection failure resulting from legacy Xbox infrastructure designed exclusively for local game play.


Developed programs to expand functionality on cloud gaming system and served as team UX lead:

• Coded C# microservices, such as client/user configuration running at start of each gaming app session to enable app features.
• Developed web UI using HTML, JavaScript, ASP.NET, and Blazor, allowing Xbox product managers, streaming team, and cross-functional partners access to control services and manage configurations.
• Implemented UI designs and testing protocols to align with company best practices for internal web tools. 
• Managed release schedule, from local to production environments, testing for standardized QA requirements in each step, integrating feedback, and fixing errors.
• Implemented web UI for critical growth initiatives for the new cloud gaming platform, including launching regional setting functionality that enabled scalability to 21 countries at launch with individual features.
• Created a new version of web UI to accommodate a more complex program with expanded progress tracking and error handling, which enabled growth to 150 games at launch and future scalability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created custom scripting web app to automate ecommerce online A/B marketing tests for online ecommerce brand to algorithmically select optimal test variables across ads, email, and website

• Refactored backend by learning and implementing newest version of Laravel to create web and Android full stack apps for local delivery company, allowing the service to scale beyond initial iOS app.

• Built Laravel-based, tinder-style ecommerce swiping application for proof-of-concept startup exploring swiping-style shopping for engagement rings. Navigated extremely ambiguous environment with only conceptual requirements to create technical plans and implement.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with team members to build series of automated Google Chart visualizations for Blue Waters supercomputer diagnostic monitoring service using Python, to provide simplified, visual feedback to scientist users and system administrators to facilitate job scheduling and launch planning. 

• Converted manual reports to automated system.
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Programming Languages · Programming · Web Design · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Python · jQuery · HTML5 · Front-end Coding
